snippet.title: FRANKIE FREAKO | Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The freaks are loose, and they're coming for your screen. Frankie Freako, the retro roguelite sidescroller based on Steven Kostanski's (Psycho Goreman, Deathstalker) cult film, is coming to Steam.

Grab your controller, dive into a chaotic world of pixel mayhem, and see how long you can survive the party when Frankie and his crew crash it. Every run is different, every freak is weirder than the last, and dying is half the fun.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383900/Frankie_Freako/

Developed by FreakZone Games
Published by Bit Bot Media
Based on the Raven Banner Entertainment film FRANKIE FREAKO by Steven Kostanski

#FrankieFreako #Roguelite #RetroGaming #IndieGame #Steam
